    Proposition 6.5(3): the radical filtration of the lifted category #

    positive-deformations.tex: "Let E be the full category on the lifted modules. The map-degree filtration has nilpotent positive part, and its degree-zero part is a product of copies of k, one for each lifted module. Its first term is therefore the categorical radical. Since the original graded Hom category is generated in degree one, descending induction through the finite filtration identifies its qth term with the qth radical power."

    Formalization. For a family of filtered lifts A i of graded modules M i, a morphism of E is a B-linear map (IsBLin), the categorical radical is IsRad (1 − hg invertible for all h), and its powers are radPow (spans of composites). Under the hypotheses of (3) the radical is the filtration order ≥ 1 (isRad_iff), and the qth radical power is the filtration order ≥ q (mem_radPow_iff).
